import hashlib
assert hashlib.sha256(open('/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py','rb').read()).hexdigest().startswith('e5dc8ef0')
s = open('/tmp/r28rev/c48.sh').read()
body = s.split("<<'EOF'\n",1)[1].rsplit('\nEOF',1)[0]
assert body.count("startswith('5683ff7b')")==1
body = body.replace("startswith('5683ff7b')", "startswith('f26d989f')")
print('columns = live r27, r28')
exec(compile(body,'c48','exec'), dict(__name__='__main__'))
